Hi Anna — thanks for the note and congrats on the traffic surge. We can absolutely support the uplift. High-level summary below; attaching a short proposal + MAP for procurement.

Summary proposal (10M tokens/mo commit):
- Monthly commit: 10M tokens/mo; list price $X per token band (see attached PDF).
- Annual prepay discount: ~12% if you sign a 12-month committed contract.
- Burst window: +40% burst capacity for 7 consecutive days with no additional provisioning (soft burst). For Black Friday we recommend a scheduled burst add-on (up to 2x) to guarantee latency SLOs.
- Rate limits: baseline per-route TPS will be increased proportionally and tracked on the Console; we can set a dedicated throughput path for your critical endpoints with priority routing.

Next steps I suggest:
1) Review attached proposal + MAP.
2) Jordan to confirm ops/playbook for scheduled burst and canary during the traffic spike.
3) Procurement to confirm billing/legal items; I’ll share a DocuSign link for a 12-month amendment if you want the annual discount.

Thanks Karthik — quick ops note from my side.

Anna, for Black Friday I suggest the following concrete plan so we don't see tail latency:
- Scheduled capacity bump: provision a temporary dedicated route 48h before peak (we can cutover traffic gradually).
- Warm-up: run a short synthetic load for 2 hours on the dedicated route to pre-warm KV caches and kernel selection paths.
- Failover: automatic fallback to a compatible quantized variant in the rare case of GPU contention (we'll keep quality baseline tests).

I'll own the runbook and be your point during the window. I can join your on-call channel during the event if you'd like.
